Composition quality of Dean Cornwell, N.C.Wyeth and Howard Pyle: compelling narrative staging, expressive silhouette and gesture, purposeful asymmetry, selected edges, broad connected value and colour masses, one decisive action. Dark fantasy is the SUBJECT, not an instruction to underexpose the picture. Hand-placed pixel clusters/hard edges/selective dithering and restricted palette as in the inspected l5/l6 surface references; do not copy their subjects or eyes. All human/dead/sculpted faces entirely indiscernible at FULL SIZE: back-facing heads, opaque hood interiors, closed helmets, corpse heads wrapped/turned away/buried. No readable eyes/nose/mouth or frontal skull portraits. Skeletal rib cages, spines, limbs, mummified torsos and anonymous corpses MUST be materially recognisable; not decorative stick scratches. Architecture and machinery are built FROM the dead, with meaningful load-bearing corpse foundations. Non-graphic decay, no exposed organs, fresh wounds or dismemberment in progress. Keep the institution’s useful action legible. Main living figures, hands and identifying working object grouped in upper central45%, but the painting is ONE continuous inhabited environment from top to bottom. Lower55% is an AREA OF REST WITH VISIBLE MATERIAL FORMS, not empty negative space: broad low-contrast mid-values, contextual ground/fabric/water/architecture, soft edges and restrained texture. It may be pale or middle-valued; reserve strongest contrast for upper action. NO blank black rectangle, fade-to-black, vignette, artificial horizontal divider, high foreground parapet, or repeated elevated walkway before a giant arch. Do not force70%dark or5%light ratios. Do not scatter equal bright highlights. Show varied viewpoints and character arrangements specified below, rather than repainting the previous composition. Read at70x100 pixels. No text, writing, UI, card border/frame, watermark or decorative pasted logo. Cult shape is diegetic physical construction, distinct from current faction allegiance. CLASS PALETTE: Warm straw/butter yellow primary, rose pink accent, subdued plum/stone. Yellow fabric is warm like aged yellow banners, not lemon, ivory or orange. PATRON: Hollow Sun: empty ring with three falling rays, never a pupil or eye; corpse-root sanctity and surrender. MATURITY: Capital: entrenched otherworldly corpse-built corruption and developed institutions. AUTHORED ACTION AND VIEWPOINT: High diagonal view of an enclosed ritual garden: two warm-yellow, rose-trimmed officiants receive a hooded adult at an empty bone sun-ring with three descending ribs. A shrouded adult body and bowl lie beside it. Mummified worshippers are fused into the ring’s roots and the garden foundation, visibly human beneath their wraps. AUTHORED RESTING ENVIRONMENT: A broad pale burial-slab path and one sweeping rose cloth continue through the lower garden, with quiet dead herbs and curved bone roots. Keep material visible and the rite compact above. Preserve the card’s existing mechanic: Consume 1 local non-specialist adult loyal to this piece’s faction. That person dies. Convert up to 1 opposing local adult to this piece’s faction. Requires 3 loyal local adult Priests, kept, and at least 1 eligible opposing adult before payment. Priest is a proposed population specialty. At most once each Faith phase. If the victim, Priests or conversion target is missing, pay nothing and produce nothing. Inherited corpses in the construction are history, not a new ongoing population cost. This particular capital rite DOES consume an adult; show the victim, useful output and institutional process without graphic injury. CRITICAL SURFACE: NOT photoreal, NOT smooth3D, NOT realistic miniature rendering. Large discrete flat pixel clusters with deliberately stepped silhouette edges and selective coarse dithering; simplify bone, grass, fabric and masonry into broad connected shapes with sparse pixel marks. No individual grass hairs or pores, no noisy realistic textures. Use supplied images ONLY for pixel-surface language, never their eye, subject, framing or palette. NO BARE SKULLS: all skeletal and corpse heads must be missing, completely wrapped in cloth, capped by closed helmets, buried or turned fully away. Keep recognisable ribs/spines/body silhouettes. No eye sockets or toothed skull faces anywhere, even background masonry. Principal live figures and identifying action remain upper central45%; lower setting is visible yet quieter and simpler than action.
